description: Open sand, blazing sun, a roaring crowd. Nowhere to hide, nothing to hide behind.
rules: A straight fight to submission — raw force and skill decide it.
No tools, no terrain, no tricks. Only what you can do with your hands and your blade.
promptFlavor: A brutal open arena where strength and steel win and clever plans wither.

description: Cramped, rain-slicked, pitch-dark. Close quarters. No room to run.
rules: Visibility is near zero — ranged advantages are heavily reduced.
No escape routes — the fight resolves to a conclusion.
promptFlavor: A claustrophobic urban kill-box where cunning beats brawn.

description: Two days to plan, gather tools, and set traps before the fight begins.
rules: Each fighter gets two days to prepare the battlefield.
The fight is won in preparation as much as in the moment.
promptFlavor: A chess match with a deadline — the better planner walks away.

description: A sub-zero whiteout with no shelter and no end to the cold.
rules: Exposure punishes anyone who can't endure.
The cold never stops — stamina and grit outlast finesse.
promptFlavor: A merciless frozen waste where the unkillable and the unbreakable thrive.

description: A dense, chaotic bazaar — improvisation and cover everywhere.
rules: Brute force is smothered by the crowd and the clutter.
Reading the room — and using it — wins.
promptFlavor: A teeming bazaar that rewards improvisers and punishes the code-bound.
